questions.behaviour: Fixed text: These are foods often linked to gas or bloating (sources: NIH, NHS). AI suggestion, may be wrong. Mark each one. Every item has three buttons: Had / Didn't have / Not sure. An untouched item is saved as Not sure, never as Didn't have. Food groups the AI did not list count as not present only when the meal was made at home (ML-06 Home) or is a saved dish the user confirmed; for every other meal they are unknown, because the AI can miss hidden ingredients.
